title.zh: 将拉古纳省帕格桑詹市镇卡班巴南村学校的名称变更为Salvador Unson小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Cabambanan Barrio School in the Municipality of Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, to Salvador Unson Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Cabambanan Barrio School in the Municipality of Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, to Salvador Unson Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Cabambanan Barrio School tại Thị trấn Pagsanjan, Tỉnh Laguna thành Trường tiểu học Salvador Unson
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Cabambanan Barrio School ในเทศบาล Pagsanjan, จังหวัด Laguna เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Salvador Unson
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Cabambanan Barrio School di Kotamadya Pagsanjan, Provinsi Laguna menjadi Sekolah Dasar Salvador Unson
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Cabambanan Barrio School di Perbandaran Pagsanjan, Wilayah Laguna menjadi Sekolah Rendah Salvador Unson

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2573_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Cabambanan Barrio School in the barrio of Cabambanan, Municipality of Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, is changed to Salvador Unson Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
